title: spinbead never claims before editing
description:
scripts/spinbead.py (and ~/scripts/spinbead.py used by OpenCode /spinbead) inventories `bd ready` once, then edits and `bd close`s without `bd update --claim`.

Failure:
- Parallel agents (Grok, other OpenCode sessions) still see the same issues in `bd ready` and edit the same files.
- Observed 2026-08-23: live /spinbead subagents were editing loadng.rs / link_layer.rs / channel_plan.py while those beads remained open/ready (e.g. 9un7, 1leg, uosr).
- Same-user claim is idempotent (`bd update --claim` succeeds if already claimed by you). Spinbead must use a distinct `--actor` (e.g. spinbead) so another agent as Mark Atwood cannot steal or double-claim.

Fix:
1. `bd update <id> --claim --actor spinbead` before any file I/O
2. Skip if claim fails (not claimable / already held)
3. `bd unclaim` if the fix cannot be applied
4. Re-inventory `bd ready` each wave instead of a stale snapshot
5. OpenCode /spinbead command must run the script, or if it orchestrates itself, claim with the same actor
notes: Hardened: claim whole wave as actor spinbead before LLM; unclaim only when zero edits; keep claim if close fails after mutation; file findings as type=bug label=codereview,spinbead; tests in scripts/test_spinbead.py (8 passed). ~/scripts/spinbead.py synced.
close_reason: spinbead now claims as --actor spinbead before any file I/O, skips failed claims, unclaims on failed fixes, and re-queries bd ready each wave. /spinbead command requires running the script instead of in-session subagents. Probed: --actor spinbead --claim sets assignee=spinbead; steal of Mark Atwood claim exits 1. Dry-run inventories without claiming.
